Please provide:

- The full transcript (doctor-patient dialogue) as the primary source.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON.

Once received, I will generate a structured SOAP Clinical Note with:
- Subjective, Objective, Assessment & Plan sections (1–5 issues as needed)
- Differential diagnoses only when consistent with the transcript (or note conflicts if present)
- Medication details with “dose/route/frequency not documented” if specifics are missing
- A “Quality checks” section noting any missing elements or transcript/DDx conflicts

Please paste the transcript and DDx in a clear format (text for transcript; valid JSON for DDx).
